title: Dedalo payout plan
description: Output of `dedalo plan --json`, and the shape of a plan stored in .dedalo/objects. Content-addressed: `id` is a hash over everything that fixes the outcome, and `created_at` is deliberately not part of it.

id.description: Content hash of the plan. Two runs over the same history and config produce the same id.

created_at.description: Unix seconds. Informational: excluded from `id`, so it cannot make two identical rounds look different.

items.description: Every transfer, contributors first. Exactly one entry per wallet: a contributor with several emails is merged before the plan is finalised.

undistributed.description: The part of the contributor pool that reached nobody. `items` plus this always equals `split.gross`.

unresolved.description: Contributors who earned a share and could not be paid. Never silently dropped.

amount.description: A count of base units. A decimal string, never a JSON number: numbers are IEEE doubles and lose precision above 2^53.

contract.description: Token contract address. Absent for a chain's native coin.

range.description: The commit range this round pays for.

from_commit.description: Exclusive lower bound: the last commit already paid for. Absent on a first round.

split.description: How the gross amount was cut. The three shares sum to `gross` exactly.

handle.description: Display name. Excluded from `id`: renaming somebody does not change what any address receives.

score.description: Attribution weight in milli-points. Zero for fee recipients. Excluded from `id` — it is why, not what.

share_bps.description: Share of the gross round in basis points, derived, for human review.

reason.description: Why they were left out. `excluded` is a decision somebody made; `no-wallet` is something somebody should fix; `ignored` is a rule in dedalo.toml.
